Zoe (Growth): Registration form fields: company size, deployment, top pain. Routing: >500 -> enterprise SDRs; private -> high-touch. Also capture one pre-submitted debug prompt.
Ravi (Ops): Green room 25m before. Need recorded rescue clip and staging VM reserved. Proposed rehearsals: Tue 09:00 PT (smoke), Thu 10:30 PT (dress).
Kai (Runtime): I'll own demos (quantized vs fp16 + prefix cache). I'll produce a 2m rescue recording. Demo commands for rehearsals will be shared.
Nina (Benchmarks): I'll prepare 3 headline charts and a gated CSV appendix. Need runtime logs by Mon.
